````text
# SpecStory CLI

`SpecStory` records terminal coding-agent sessions and can wrap supported agents with `specstory run`.

## Installation in This Dotfiles Repo

`specstory` is installed automatically by the `coding_agents` ansible role.

- macOS: Homebrew preferred, with a GitHub release fallback to `~/.local/bin`
- Linux: GitHub release tarball installed to `~/.local/bin`

## Global vs Project Config

This dotfiles repo manages the user-level SpecStory config at `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`.

SpecStory reads configuration in this order:

1. User-level config: `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`
2. Project-level config: `./.specstory/cli/config.toml`
3. CLI flags passed to `specstory`

Later sources override earlier ones. That means the dotfile provides global defaults, while a repo-specific `.specstory/cli/config.toml` can override them when a project needs different behavior.

!!! note "Seeded once, not continuously managed"
    The user-level config is a chezmoi `create_` file (`private_dot_specstory/private_cli/create_config.toml`): chezmoi writes it on first `apply` and then **never touches it again**. This is deliberate — the SpecStory CLI writes runtime UI state back into the file (e.g. a `[resume]` block with `view_mode` / `last_agent` after `specstory resume`), which would otherwise show up as permanent chezmoi drift. To change the shipped defaults, edit the source and re-seed: `cp ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml "$(chezmoi source-path ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml)"`.

## Managed Defaults

The managed config keeps the upstream sample sections as commented documentation, but only enables `[providers]` defaults.

Configured providers:

- `antigravity_cmd = "agy --dangerously-skip-permissions"`
- `claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"`
- `codex_cmd = 'codex --ask-for-approval never --sandbox danger-full-access -c model_reasoning_summary="detailed"'`
- `cursor_cmd = "cursor-agent --force"`
- `droid_cmd = "droid --yolo"`
- `gemini_cmd = "gemini --sandbox=none"`

These are the commands `specstory run claude`, `specstory run codex`, and similar provider shortcuts will execute by default unless overridden per project or on the command line.

Codex 0.156.0 rejects the old `model_supports_reasoning_summaries` override and reports it as an ignored `session-flags` setting at startup. Keep `model_reasoning_summary="detailed"` to request detailed summaries. On existing hosts, remove only `-c model_supports_reasoning_summaries=true` from `codex_cmd` in `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` (and any project override); `chezmoi apply` does not update this seed-only file. Restart the Codex session to use the corrected command.

### Always name the provider — the no-arg default is not stable

`<id>_cmd` controls **how** a provider launches, never **which** one bare `specstory run` picks. There is no `default_provider` key: with no argument, specstory resolves to the **alphabetically-first** entry of its provider registry. Adding `antigravity` in 2.9.0 therefore silently displaced `claude` as the default on every existing install, and `specstory run --help` re-generated itself to match (`By default, launches Antigravity CLI.`). Since `agy` was installed, the wrong agent launched successfully with no error.

Always write `specstory run claude`. This repo's wrappers do — see `_sesh_wrap_agent()` in `dot_config/shell/22_sesh.sh` (shared by `scode` / `svibe` / `hcode` / `hvibe`) and [pitfalls/specstory-run-default-agent-drift.md](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/specstory-run-default-agent-drift.md).

## Optional export after a Copilot session

`claude-copilot-once --specstory-mode exit` and
`codex-copilot-once --specstory-mode exit` run the agent directly and export
same-project/provider history after exit. Default `run` still records live;
`off` / `--no-specstory` skips a new recording request. Both `run` and `exit`
inherit provider commands from the real TOML configuration. Explicit caller
permissions override those defaults; the launchers supply bypass only where
no posture was chosen. See the [recording lifecycle](copilot-claude-proxy.md#recording---specstory-mode-runexitoff)
for concurrency, pending recovery and signal limitations. These helpers never
commit the export automatically.

## Safety Tradeoff

The configured provider commands intentionally favor low-friction agent execution:

- Claude uses `--dangerously-skip-permissions`
- Codex uses `--ask-for-approval never` and `--sandbox danger-full-access`
- Antigravity uses `--dangerously-skip-permissions`; Cursor uses `--force` and Droid `--yolo`
- Gemini uses `--sandbox=none`

This removes most interactive permission prompts, which is useful for fast local workflows, but it also gives the wrapped agents broader filesystem or command access. Keep these defaults only if you trust the environment and want convenience over stricter guardrails. If not, override the relevant provider command in the global file, a project-local config, or the `specstory run -c ...` flag.

## Verify

```bash
specstory --version
specstory run codex --help
chezmoi diff
```

## See also

- [SpecStory internals (filename algorithm, reverse lookup, markdown structure)](specstory-internals.md) — what this repo's `tv agent-sessions` channel uses to link live sessions back to `.specstory/history/*.md`.

## References

- [SpecStory CLI usage docs](https://docs.specstory.com/integrations/terminal-coding-agents/usage#configuration)
- [SpecStory CLI releases](https://github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/releases)
- [SpecStory CLI source on DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/specstoryai/getspecstory) — generated technical reference for the Go implementation.

# Passing args to a specstory-wrapped agent silently drops `claude_cmd` flags → session lands in the wrong permission mode

**Symptoms** (grep this section):
- `claude-copilot-once` (no args) starts Claude Code in **bypass-permissions**
  mode, but `claude-copilot-once --resume <id>` starts in **`auto`** mode —
  same wrapper, same project, same shell, opposite behaviour
- Claude Code shows the permission prompt / `⏵⏵ auto-accept edits off` banner
  only when you pass arguments
- `/status` inside the session reports the permission mode coming from
  `~/.claude/settings.json` (`permissions.defaultMode`) instead of the
  `--dangerously-skip-permissions` you configured in specstory
- Nothing is logged, nothing warns, and `specstory check claude` reports
  `✅ All systems go!` in both cases
- Applies equally to any other flag in `claude_cmd` (`--model`, `--add-dir`, …)
  and to the sibling `codex_cmd` / `cursor_cmd` / `droid_cmd` / `gemini_cmd`
  entries

**First seen**: 2026-07
**Affects**: specstory CLI 2.5.0 (`specstory run <provider> -c …`);
`claude-copilot` / `claude-copilot-once` in `dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh`
**Status**: by-design upstream; fixed locally in `43_copilot_proxy.sh`

## Symptom

With this in `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`:

```toml
[providers]
claude_cmd = "claude --dangerously-skip-permissions"
```

these two commands run in **different permission modes**:

```sh
claude-copilot-once                   # bypass permissions  ✅
claude-copilot-once --resume <id>     # auto (the ~/.claude default)  ❌
```

## Root cause

specstory's `-c/--command` **replaces** the provider's configured command; it
does **not** append to it. The two are the same slot — the shipped config file
says so in its own comment:

> Agent execution commands by provider (used by `specstory run`).
> Pass custom flags (e.g. `claude_cmd = "claude --allow-dangerously-skip-permissions"`).
> **Use of these is equivalent to `-c "custom command"`.**

`claude-copilot` used to branch like this:

```sh
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
  copilot-run specstory run claude -c "claude $*"   # ← clobbers claude_cmd
else
  copilot-run specstory run claude                  # ← claude_cmd applies
fi
```

So the *presence of arguments* silently decided whether your configured flags
were honoured. The no-arg path never passes `-c`, so `claude_cmd` wins; the
moment you pass anything through, the hardcoded bare `claude` in the `-c` string
becomes the entire command and every configured flag is gone. Claude Code then
falls back to `~/.claude/settings.json`'s `permissions.defaultMode` (`"auto"`
in this repo), which is exactly what the user observes.

Verified with a fake agent that logs its own argv:

```
# specstory run claude                       (claude_cmd = "<fake> --from-config")
ARGV: --from-config
# specstory run claude -c "<fake> --resume abc123"
ARGV: --resume abc123          ← --from-config is gone, not merged
```

## Fix

Rebuild the base command from specstory's own config instead of hardcoding
`claude`, so the config stays the single source of truth for **both** branches.
`_copilot_specstory_claude_cmd` in `dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh` reads
the effective `claude_cmd` honouring specstory's precedence (project
`./.specstory/cli/config.toml` > user `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` > bare
`claude`), and `claude-copilot` appends the passthrough args to it.

Two non-obvious constraints in that helper:

- **Skip commented lines.** Both shipped configs carry a commented
  `# claude_cmd = "claude"` example. A naive `grep claude_cmd` matches the
  project-level comment first and pins a bare `claude` — re-introducing the very
  bug it is meant to fix.
- **Quote each passthrough arg.** specstory shell-splits the `-c` string
  honouring quotes (`-p 'a b'` arrives as one argv entry), so the old
  `"claude $*"` also flattened `claude-copilot -p "two words"` into two separate
  arguments. Each arg is now single-quoted with the POSIX `'\''` escape.

## Why not fix it the other two ways

- **Change `~/.claude/settings.json` → `defaultMode: "bypassPermissions"`.**
  That file is chezmoi-managed and global, so it would put *every* Claude Code
  session on every project into bypass mode — including plain `claude` on the
  real Anthropic backend, which is far more blast radius than the copilot
  wrappers asked for.
- **Hardcode `--dangerously-skip-permissions` into the shell function.** Splits
  the source of truth in two: the specstory config would silently stop being
  authoritative for the args path, and the next person to edit `claude_cmd`
  would be baffled again.
````

```markdown
# SpecStory config template 更新

## Context 背景

- `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` 落後的主因**不是 template 沒更新**，而是它是 `create_` 檔：只 seed 一次，之後 chezmoi 不再動它。
  - Source template 已經有 `antigravity_cmd`、`[redaction]`，codex 也拿掉了 `model_reasoning_effort="high"`。
  - 那個 `high` 是最初 commit `59a22aa3`（"Add SpecStory user-level config for YOLO mode"）帶進來的，後來的 template 已清掉，但本機 deployed 檔一直沒 re-seed。
- SpecStory 2.17.0 目前支援的 `*_cmd` key（從 binary 取出）：antigravity, claude, codex, copilot, copilotide, cursor, cursorcloud, cursoride, deepseek, droid, gemini, grok, muse, opencode, pi, qwen, shell。Template 只寫了 6 個。
- 順便修一個 bug：`gemini_cmd = "gemini --sandbox=none"` 根本不是 bypass——真正的 approval bypass 是 `--yolo`。

決策（已確認）：Claude 維持 `--dangerously-skip-permissions`；Codex 改用單一 `--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox`，保留 `model_reasoning_summary="detailed"`。

## Changes 變更

### 1. `private_dot_specstory/private_cli/create_config.toml` — `[providers]`
依 provider 字母順序，每個都附一行註解說明 flag：

| key | value | 依據 |
|---|---|---|
| `antigravity_cmd` | `agy --dangerously-skip-permissions`（不變） | `agy --help` |
| `claude_cmd` | `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions`（不變） | 使用者決定 |
| `codex_cmd` | `codex --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox -c model_reasoning_summary="detailed"` | `codex --help` |
| `copilot_cmd` | `copilot --yolo`（新增；本機未安裝，註明待驗證） | Copilot CLI `--yolo`/`--allow-all` |
| `cursor_cmd` | `cursor-agent --force`（不變） | `cursor-agent --help` |
| `droid_cmd` | `droid --yolo`（不變） | — |
| `gemini_cmd` | `gemini --yolo`（**修正**） | `gemini --help` |
| `opencode_cmd` | `opencode --auto`（新增） | `opencode --help`：auto-approve not-denied |
| `pi_cmd` | `pi`（新增；pi 沒有 permission 系統，寫出來只為完整/文件化） | `pi --help` |
| `qwen_cmd` | `qwen --yolo`（新增；gemini fork，未安裝，註明待驗證） | — |

- `deepseek` / `grok` / `muse`：不確定 bypass flag 且本機未安裝 → 以**註解**列出 `# deepseek_cmd = "deepseek"` 等，標註「flag unverified」，不猜。
- `copilotide` / `cursoride` / `cursorcloud`：IDE/cloud provider，`run` 不 launch 本地 CLI → 不寫。
- 保留現有的「always name the provider」註解。
- 實作時先 `specstory check copilot`/`qwen`（help 或 docs）快速確認 flag；查不到就降級為註解。

### 2. 本機 deployed 檔 re-seed（`~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`）
`create_` 不會自動更新。做法：用新 template 覆蓋 deployed，但**保留**它的 `[resume]` block（specstory runtime state：`view_mode`/`last_agent`）。即 `chezmoi cat` 新內容 + append 原 `[resume]`。

### 3. Docs 同步
- `docs/tools/specstory.md` + `docs/tools/specstory.zh-TW.md`：§ Managed Defaults provider 清單、§ Safety Tradeoff；把 Codex 0.156 那段改寫成「existing hosts 要手動 re-seed」的通用說明（加上 gemini `--sandbox=none` → `--yolo` 修正）。
- `README.md:258` 那行描述更新（提到涵蓋更多 provider）。
- 檢查 `dot_config/shell/43_copilot_proxy.sh` / `copilot-session.py` 是否 parse `codex_cmd` 內容並假設 `--ask-for-approval`（若有，跟著調整/測試）。

## Verification 驗證

1. `python3 -c 'import tomllib;tomllib.load(open(...))'` 驗 TOML。
2. 用 app 驗：`specstory check`（確認 config 被讀、無 error）；對已安裝的 provider 用 fake-argv 方式或 `specstory run <p> --help` 確認指令被接受：codex、gemini、opencode、pi 各自 `<cmd> --help` 不報 unknown flag。
3. `grep -rn "ask-for-approval\|codex_cmd" dot_config/shell tests/` → 若有相依，跑 `bats tests/unit/copilot_proxy.bats` 與 `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_copilot_session.py`。
4. `just docs-build`。
5. `chezmoi diff ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` 應只剩 `[resume]` 差異（create_ 不會覆寫）。
```

```text
            if command.strip():
                return command
    return provider


# Options with values must be consumed before examining flag-looking prompt or
# settings data. -p/--print is a boolean in Claude, not a prompt-value option.
VALUE_FLAGS = {
    "--settings", "--model", "-m", "--permission-mode", "--permission-prompts",
    "--permission-prompt-tool", "--append-system-prompt", "--system-prompt",
    "--append-system-prompt-file", "--system-prompt-file", "--resume", "-r",
    "--session-id", "--agent", "--agents", "--effort", "--name", "-n",
    "--input-format", "--output-format", "--json-schema", "--max-budget-usd",
    "--setting-sources", "--fallback-model", "--debug-file", "--autocompact",
    "--ask-for-approval", "-a", "--sandbox", "-s", "--config", "--profile",
    "--cd", "-C",
}
CLAUDE_POLICY = {
    "--dangerously-skip-permissions", "--permission-mode", "--restricted",
    "--permission-prompts", "--permission-prompt-tool",
}
CODEX_COMPOUND = {"--full-auto", "--approve-for-me", "--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox"}


def options(argv, provider):
    """Yield (start, end, option, value), stopping at the explicit -- boundary."""
    index = 0
    while index < len(argv):
        arg = argv[index]
        if arg == "--":
            return
        key, equals, value = arg.partition("=")
        if key == "-c" and provider == "codex":
            takes_value = True
        else:
            takes_value = key in VALUE_FLAGS
        # Codex supports attached short values, e.g. -sread-only and -cfoo=1.
        if provider == "codex" and arg[:2] in ("-m", "-s", "-a", "-c", "-C") and len(arg) > 2:
            key, value, equals, takes_value = arg[:2], arg[2:].removeprefix("="), True, True
        end = index + 1
        if takes_value and not equals:
            if provider == "claude" and key in ("--resume", "-r") and (end >= len(argv) or argv[end].startswith("-")):
                yield index, end, key, None
                index = end
                continue
            if end >= len(argv) or argv[end] == "--":
                raise Error(f"{key} needs a value")
            value = argv[end]
            end += 1
        yield index, end, key, value if takes_value or equals else None
        index = end


def settings_arg(argv):
    result, retained, end = {}, [], 0
    for start, stop, key, value in options(argv, "claude"):
        retained.extend(argv[end:start])
        if key == "--settings":
            if value.lstrip().startswith("{"):
                text = value
                label = "--settings"
            else:
                path = Path(value).expanduser()
                try:
                    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
                except OSError as exc:
                    raise Error(f"cannot read --settings file {path}: {exc}") from exc
                label = str(path)
            result = object_json(text, label)
        else:
            retained.extend(argv[start:stop])
        end = stop
    retained.extend(argv[end:])
    for field in ("env", "permissions"):
        if field in result and not isinstance(result[field], dict):
            raise Error(f"--settings {field} must be an object")
    return result, retained


def command_prefix(argv):
    """Support SpecStory's executable wrappers and env assignments, not eval."""
    if os.path.basename(argv[0]) != "env":
        if os.path.basename(argv[0]) in ("sh", "bash", "zsh", "dash"):
            raise Error("shell-expression provider commands cannot receive agent overrides; use an executable wrapper forwarding its arguments")
        return 1
    index = 1
    while index < len(argv):
        item = argv[index]
        if item == "--":
            index += 1
            break
        if item in ("-i", "--ignore-environment") or "=" in item and not item.startswith("-"):
            index += 1
        elif item in ("-u", "--unset"):
            index += 2
        elif item.startswith("--unset="):
            index += 1
        elif item.startswith("-"):
            raise Error(f"unsupported env wrapper option {item}; use an executable wrapper")
        else:
            break
    if index >= len(argv):
        raise Error("env provider command needs an agent executable")
    return index + 1


def codex_config(argv):
    config = {}
    for _, _, key, value in options(argv, "codex"):
        if key in ("-c", "--config"):
            name, separator, raw = value.partition("=")
            if not separator:
                raise Error(f"{key} needs key=value (check the SpecStory codex_cmd)")
            try:
                parsed = tomllib.loads("value=" + raw)["value"]
            except ValueError:
                parsed = raw
            config[name.strip()] = parsed
    return config


def policy_axes(argv, provider, settings=None):
    opts = {key for _, _, key, _ in options(argv, provider)}
    if provider == "claude":
        permissions = (settings or {}).get("permissions", {})
        explicit = isinstance(permissions, dict) and "defaultMode" in permissions
        return {"permission"} if opts & CLAUDE_POLICY or explicit else set()
    config = codex_config(argv)
    axes = set()
    if opts & CODEX_COMPOUND:
        return {"approval", "sandbox"}
    if opts & {"-a", "--ask-for-approval"} or "approval_policy" in config:
        axes.add("approval")
    if opts & {"-s", "--sandbox"} or "sandbox_mode" in config:
        axes.add("sandbox")
    return axes


def strip_policy(argv, provider, axes):
    result, end = [], 0
    for start, stop, key, value in options(argv, provider):
        remove = False
        if provider == "claude":
            remove = "permission" in axes and key in CLAUDE_POLICY
        else:
            remove = (key in CODEX_COMPOUND and bool(axes)
                      or "approval" in axes and key in ("-a", "--ask-for-approval")
                      or "sandbox" in axes and key in ("-s", "--sandbox"))
            if key in ("-c", "--config"):
                name = value.partition("=")[0].strip()
                remove = (name == "approval_policy" and "approval" in axes
                          or name == "sandbox_mode" and "sandbox" in axes)
        result.extend(argv[end:start])
        if not remove:
            result.extend(argv[start:stop])
        end = stop
    result.extend(argv[end:])
    return result


def inspect(provider, mode, user_args):
    use_config = mode == "exit" or mode == "run" and shutil.which("specstory")
    base = split_command(specstory_command(provider)) if use_config else [provider]
    if not base:
        base = [provider]
    base[0] = os.path.expanduser(base[0])
    head = command_prefix(base)
    base[head - 1] = os.path.expanduser(base[head - 1])
    user_settings = settings_arg(user_args)[0] if provider == "claude" else {}
    axes = policy_axes(user_args, provider, user_settings)
    base_args = base[head:]
    if provider == "codex" and axes:
        expanded, end = [], 0
        for start, stop, key, _ in options(base_args, provider):
            expanded.extend(base_args[end:start])
            if key == "--full-auto":
                expanded.extend(["-a", "on-request", "-s", "workspace-write"])
            elif key == "--dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox":
                expanded.extend(["-a", "never", "-s", "danger-full-access"])
            elif key == "--approve-for-me" and len(axes) == 1:
                raise Error("configured --approve-for-me controls both permission axes; specify both approval and sandbox explicitly")
            else:
                expanded.extend(base_args[start:stop])
            end = stop
        expanded.extend(base_args[end:])
        base_args = expanded
    base_args = strip_policy(base_args, provider, axes)
    args = base_args + list(user_args)
    settings = {}
    if provider == "claude":
        settings, args = settings_arg(args)
        # --settings defaultMode is also an explicit user permission choice.
        if "permission" in policy_axes([], provider, settings):
            args = strip_policy(args, provider, {"permission"}) if not policy_axes(user_args, provider) else args
        if not policy_axes(args, provider, settings):
            args = ["--dangerously-skip-permissions", *args]
    else:
        present = policy_axes(args, provider)
        for axis, flag, value in (("approval", "--ask-for-approval", "never"),
                                  ("sandbox", "--sandbox", "danger-full-access")):
            if axis not in present:
                args = [flag, value, *args]
    config = codex_config(args) if provider == "codex" else {}
    model = config.get("model", "")
    if provider == "claude":
        env = settings.get("env", {})
        model = settings.get("model") or (env.get("ANTHROPIC_MODEL", "") if isinstance(env, dict) else "")
    for _, _, key, value in options(args, provider):
        if key in ("-m", "--model"):
            model = value
    return {"argv": [*base[:head], *args], "head": head, "settings": settings, "model": model or "",
            "config": config}

    origin = cwd = Path.cwd()
```

_**Agent (claude-opus-5-5 2026-11-17 08:10:27Z)**_

你記得的 credential 那層有關係，不過不在 config 裡：token 一直都放在獨立的 `auth.json`，從來沒寫進 `config.toml`。兩個前綴的理由不一樣。

**`private_`（加在目錄上）：讓 chezmoi 保持 `~/.specstory/cli` 的 0700 權限**
- `private_` 只加在 `private_dot_specstory/private_cli/` 這兩層目錄上，不在檔案本身，所以 `config.toml` 部署出來是 0644。
- `~/.specstory/cli/` 裡還有 SpecStory 自己寫的 `auth.json`（0600），內容只有 `cloud_access` 和 `cloud_refresh` 兩個雲端 token，跟 `config.toml` 完全分開。
- SpecStory 自己把這個目錄設成 0700。chezmoi 管這個目錄，所以如果沒加 `private_`，每次 apply 都會把它改回 0755，把 token 所在的目錄權限放寬，還會一直出現 mode drift。原理跟 `private_dot_ssh` 一樣。

**`create_`（加在檔案上）：因為 SpecStory 會把執行時的狀態寫回這個檔**
- 一開始（3 月的 `59a22aa3`）是一般受管理的檔案，7 月 `ea1443e4` 才改成 `create_`。
- 原因是 `specstory resume` 會把 `[resume]` 區塊（`view_mode`、`last_agent`）寫回 `config.toml`。一般受管理的檔案每次 apply 都會跟這個區塊打架，出現永久 drift。這段原因寫在 `docs/tools/specstory.md` 的 note 裡。
- 代價就是那位 side agent 提醒的：改了 template，已經存在的檔案不會跟著更新。

**side agent 的提醒，這次已經處理了**：本機檔案已經從新 template 重新寫入，`[resume]` 也保留了，所以不需要刪掉重新 apply。fleet 上的其他主機一樣要各自跑一次文件 § Managed Defaults 裡的 re-seed 指令。

如果想擺脫手動 re-seed，可以把它改成 `modify_` 腳本：只負責維護 `[providers]`，其他內容（包括 `[resume]`）原樣保留。repo 裡 `~/.claude/settings.json` 和幾個 agent CLI 設定就是這樣處理的。代價是要多寫一個 TOML merge 腳本。要做的話我可以接著改。

```text
#!/bin/sh
# chezmoi modify_ script: overlay a managed herdr config onto ~/.config/herdr/config.toml.
#
# Why: Herdr is a foreign writer for this file. Current releases persist
# onboarding, update-channel, theme/UI/sound/toast/pane-label/agent-sort, and
# key-reset changes. Tracking the file as plain managed content would create two
# writers. It was previously `create_` (seed-once), but that also prevented later
# repo edits from reaching an already-seeded host. This preventive `modify_`
# overlay enforces our managed tables ([theme], [ui], [terminal], [keys]) on
# every `chezmoi apply` while preserving every other top-level key.
#
# How: chezmoi pipes the current target file into stdin; this script prints the
# new contents on stdout.
#
# Merge model — template-as-base, pull-through unmanaged keys:
#   - Base = the managed template (.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml), which
#     carries the comments + the tmux-parity rationale.
#   - For every TOP-LEVEL key in the live file NOT in {theme, ui, terminal,
#     keys}, copy it into the base. `onboarding` and [update] include current
#     Herdr writes; [session], [remote], [experimental], and unknown sections are
#     deliberately preserved as live/user-owned configuration too.
#   - Managed tables are enforced wholesale (template wins) — this is a managed
#     dotfile; in-app theme/UI/key changes are intentionally re-asserted.
#
# Why tomlkit (not codex's inline emitter): herdr's config has an
# array-of-tables ([[keys.command]]) and comments we want to keep; stdlib
# tomllib is read-only and the codex modify_ emitter can't emit AoT. tomlkit
# round-trips both.
#
# Note: the template is written to a temp file via a heredoc *redirect* (not
# captured with $(...)), because the config body contains a lone backtick
# (`key = "prefix+\`"`) that bash mis-parses as command substitution when a
# quoted heredoc is nested inside $(...). Passing the path to Python sidesteps it.
#
# To manage an additional key: edit .chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml.
# Python runtime: prefer `uv` (guarantees Python >=3.11 → stdlib tomllib), fall
# back to system python3, then to printing the raw template unmodified (a
# fresh-bootstrap host with neither uv nor python3 still gets a full config —
# note we print the TEMPLATE, not stdin, because on a fresh host stdin is empty).
set -eu

tmpl_file=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/herdr-config.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmpl_file"' EXIT INT TERM

cat <<'TOML' > "$tmpl_file"
{{ template "herdr/config.toml" . }}
TOML

live=$(cat)

if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  set -- uv run --no-project --quiet --with tomlkit --python '>=3.11' python -
elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  set -- python3 -
else
  echo "modify_config.toml: neither uv nor python3 found; emitting managed template" >&2
  cat "$tmpl_file"
  exit 0
fi
```
</details></tool-use>

```text
import os
import sys

tmpl_path = os.environ["HERDR_TEMPLATE_FILE"]
with open(tmpl_path, "r") as fh:
    template_text = fh.read()


def emit_template():
    sys.stdout.write(template_text)


# Read side: stdlib tomllib (uv guarantees >=3.11); tomli backport otherwise.
try:
    import tomllib  # Python 3.11+
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    try:
        import tomli as tomllib
    except ModuleNotFoundError:
        # No TOML reader → can't safely merge; ship the managed template as-is
        # (loses runtime-key preservation, but keeps the host configured).
        emit_template()
        sys.exit(0)

# Write side: tomlkit preserves comments + array-of-tables. uv installs it via
# --with tomlkit; a bare system python3 may lack it → fall back to raw template.
try:
    import tomlkit
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    print(
        "modify_config.toml: tomlkit unavailable; emitting managed template "
        "(runtime keys not preserved this run)",
        file=sys.stderr,
    )
    emit_template()
    sys.exit(0)

MANAGED = {"theme", "ui", "terminal", "keys"}

live_text = os.environ.get("HERDR_LIVE", "").strip()
doc = tomlkit.parse(template_text)  # base, with comments intact
live = tomllib.loads(live_text) if live_text else {}

# Pull through every unmanaged top-level key, whether Herdr- or user-owned.
for key, value in live.items():
    if key in MANAGED or key in doc:
        continue
    doc[key] = value

sys.stdout.write(tomlkit.dumps(doc))
```

```tmpl
#!/bin/sh
# chezmoi modify_ script: overlay managed SpecStory defaults onto
# ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml.
#
# Why: SpecStory is a foreign writer for this file — `specstory resume` persists
# a [resume] table (view_mode / last_agent). It was previously `create_`
# (seed-once), which avoided drift but meant template edits (new providers,
# privacy defaults) never reached an already-seeded host.
#
# Merge model — template-as-base, per-key pull-through:
#   - Base = .chezmoitemplates/specstory/config.toml (keeps upstream comments).
#   - Every ACTIVE key in the template wins (e.g. providers.*_cmd,
#     analytics.enabled, redaction.enabled).
#   - Live keys the template doesn't set are copied in: unknown tables like
#     [resume] wholesale, and extra keys inside managed tables (e.g. a host-local
#     `local_sync.local_time_zone = true`).
#   - Consequence: deleting a key from the template does NOT remove it from
#     hosts; set it to the desired value instead.
#
# Python runtime: prefer uv (guarantees tomllib + tomlkit), then python3; with
# neither, or without tomlkit, print the template (a fresh host still gets a
# full config; only [resume] UI state is lost for that run).
set -eu

tmpl_file=$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/specstory-config.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -f "$tmpl_file"' EXIT INT TERM

cat <<'TOML' > "$tmpl_file"
{{ template "specstory/config.toml" . }}
TOML

live=$(cat)

if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  set -- uv run --no-project --quiet --with tomlkit --python '>=3.11' python -
elif command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  set -- python3 -
else
  echo "modify_config.toml (specstory): neither uv nor python3 found; emitting managed template" >&2
  cat "$tmpl_file"
  exit 0
fi

SPECSTORY_TEMPLATE_FILE="$tmpl_file" SPECSTORY_LIVE="$live" "$@" <<'PYEOF'
import os
import sys

with open(os.environ["SPECSTORY_TEMPLATE_FILE"]) as fh:
    template_text = fh.read()

try:
    import tomllib
    import tomlkit
except ModuleNotFoundError:
    print("modify_config.toml (specstory): tomllib/tomlkit unavailable; "
          "emitting managed template", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.stdout.write(template_text)
    sys.exit(0)

live_text = os.environ.get("SPECSTORY_LIVE", "")
try:
    live = tomllib.loads(live_text) if live_text.strip() else {}
except tomllib.TOMLDecodeError as exc:
    # Don't silently discard a hand-broken file's intent; fail the apply loudly.
    print(f"modify_config.toml (specstory): live config is not valid TOML: {exc}",
          file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

doc = tomlkit.parse(template_text)
for key, value in live.items():
    if key not in doc:
        doc[key] = value
    elif isinstance(value, dict) and isinstance(doc[key], dict):
        for sub, sub_value in value.items():
            if sub not in doc[key]:
                doc[key][sub] = sub_value

out = tomlkit.dumps(doc)
sys.stdout.write(out if out.endswith("\n") else out + "\n")
PYEOF

```

To add flags for a newly-registered provider, use its `<id>_cmd` key in
`private_dot_specstory/private_cli/create_config.toml` (and hand-copy into the
live `~/.specstory/cli/config.toml` — it's a `create_` file, so chezmoi seeds
it once and never touches it again):

```toml
# Antigravity CLI command (binary is `agy`; add `--effort high` if wanted)
antigravity_cmd = "agy --dangerously-skip-permissions"
```


`SpecStory` 依以下順序讀取設定：

1. 使用者層級設定：`~/.specstory/cli/config.toml`
2. 專案層級設定：`./.specstory/cli/config.toml`
3. 傳給 `specstory` 的 CLI flag

後者覆蓋前者。也就是說 dotfile 提供全域預設值，而 repo 專屬的 `.specstory/cli/config.toml` 可在專案需要不同行為時覆寫之。

!!! note "只種一次 (seed once)，不持續管理"
    使用者層級設定是 chezmoi 的 `create_` 檔（`private_dot_specstory/private_cli/create_config.toml`）：chezmoi 只在第一次 `apply` 時寫入，之後**不再更動它**。這是刻意設計的 —— SpecStory CLI 會把執行期的 UI 狀態寫回這個檔（例如 `specstory resume` 之後產生的 `[resume]` 區塊，含 `view_mode` / `last_agent`），若持續管理就會變成永久的 chezmoi drift。要修改內建預設值，請改 source 檔再重新種一次：`cp ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml "$(chezmoi source-path ~/.specstory/cli/config.toml)"`。


| Key | Command | Bypass mechanism |
|---|---|---|
| `antigravity_cmd` | `agy --dangerously-skip-permissions` | auto-approve all tool requests |
| `claude_cmd` | `claude --dangerously-skip-permissions` | bypassPermissions (`--permission-mode auto` is the classifier-gated alternative) |
57:**更新既有主機**：`chezmoi apply` 不會改寫這個只種一次的檔案。從 template 重新種一次，同時保留 SpecStory 執行期的 `[resume]` 區塊：

SpecStory is a foreign writer: `specstory resume` writes a `[resume]` table (`view_mode` / `last_agent`) back into the file, so a plain managed file would drift forever. On every `chezmoi apply`, each **active** key in the template wins; every other live key is kept: unknown tables such as `[resume]` wholesale, plus extra keys inside managed tables, for example a host-local `local_time_zone = true` under `[local_sync]`. Deleting a key from the template does **not** remove it from hosts, so set it to the value you want instead. Invalid TOML in the live file fails the apply loudly rather than being overwritten. Edit the template, never `chezmoi add` the target (that would overwrite the script). The file used to be `create_` (seed-once), which meant template updates never reached existing hosts.

SpecStory 設定已經改成 `modify_`，也已經套用到這台；analytics 關掉了，redaction 明確打開。還沒 commit。

**`modify_` 怎麼運作**
- **檔案**：模板移到 `.chezmoitemplates/specstory/config.toml`，由 `private_dot_specstory/private_cli/modify_private_config.toml.tmpl` 產生最終設定檔，寫法照 herdr 現有的那套。
- **合併規則**：模板裡有寫值的 key 每次 apply 都以模板為準；其他東西都保留，包括 `[resume]`，以及你在某台機器自己加的 key（例如 `local_time_zone = true`）。
- **限制**：從模板刪掉一個 key，不會讓它從主機上消失，要改成你想要的值。
- **其他機器**：下次 `chezmoi apply` 或 `fleet-apply` 就會更新，不用再手動處理。
- **測試**：試過現有檔、空檔、舊值加本機 key、壞掉的 TOML（apply 會直接報錯，不會覆蓋）四種情況，跑兩次結果一樣。套用後 `chezmoi diff` 是空的，`just docs-build` 沒有 warning。
- **檔名多了 `private_`**：套用後 SpecStory 自己改寫這個檔時把權限改回 0600，不加的話每次 `resume` 都會出現權限 drift。

**其他設定的 review**

| 設定 | 處理 | 原因 |
|---|---|---|
| `[analytics]` | `enabled = false` | 不需要送使用統計 |
| `[redaction]` | 明確寫 `enabled = true` | 預設本來就開；寫出來是怕上游改預設時悄悄關掉 |
| `[cloud_sync]` | 照你選的維持預設 | 有登入才會同步 |
| `[telemetry] prompts` | 不動，加了註解 | 沒設 endpoint 就不會送任何東西 |
| `version_check`、`logging`、`local_sync` | 不動 | 沒有隱私問題 |

文件（中英文兩份）、README 和 `pitfalls/specstory-run-default-agent-drift.md` 也一起更新了。

**analytics 一般記錄什麼**

我從 `specstory` 執行檔的字串看，它用的是 PostHog，裡面看得到這些欄位：`$device_id`（裝置識別碼）、`$os` / `os_version` / `$go_version`、`error_type`，還有指令和 flag 相關的字串。這類 CLI 通常記的是你跑了哪個指令、用哪個 agent、版本、OS、錯誤類型、次數。我沒有抓實際送出去的封包，所以有沒有帶對話內容不能百分之百確定，不過照慣例和欄位名稱看起來是沒有的。

至於「已經同步聊天紀錄，是不是無所謂了」：對 SpecStory 這家公司來說，大致是這樣。Cloud sync 送過去的是整段對話，analytics 那點資料跟它比起來很小。兩者的差別在於：
- **對象可能不同**：analytics 會送到 PostHog 這個第三方，不只 SpecStory 自己。
- **性質不同**：cloud sync 是你登入時主動選的功能，analytics 是預設就開、不知不覺在送。

關掉 analytics 沒有任何功能上的代價，所以還是建議關。要更保護隱私的話，該處理的是 cloud sync 本身，例如只在特定 repo 用專案層的設定打開。

要 commit 的話跟我說。
